remarks: Welcome to this charming  Cape Cod that lives like a ranch with the convenience of a first-floor bedroom, full bath, and laundry. The flexible first-floor layout also includes an additional room that can serve as a formal dining room, den, home office, or playroom to suit your needs. Pride in ownership is evident in the many updates in the kitchen, including new granite countertops with custom iron supports,  a new dishwasher, and an exhaust fan. Rounding out the recent updates are a new washer and dryer and an electric subpanel. Upstairs you will find 2 bedrooms and a half bath providing a comfortable and private retreat. Step outside to enjoy the fully fenced backyard, complete with a sprinkler system to help maintain the lawn with ease, ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or pets. A detached 2-car garage provides plenty of space for parking, storage, or hobbies. Conveniently located in the city within walking distance to schools and close to shopping, dining, and other amenities, this home offers both comfort, flexibility, and everyday convenience.
